name: Boston
note: aerial-photograph ground (no open LiDAR over the built-up city: bare-earth LiDAR erases the streets); the street grid, the harbour and Charles-River shorelines and the parks carry the fit; the 1902 staged sheet is a steep near-vertical view (the grid dense and legible, a printed key of landmarks) spanning the whole city far beyond the 2000 m town box, so its fit is likely to end a review item (the 236a NY-1811 / DC-ring precedent)
